title: Interview G20LAP-2 on sustainable finance
descriptions: G20LAP-2 works on sustainable finance in the Swiss Banking Association. The discussion touched upon the functioning of the SBA, the main policy debates around sustainable finance, the relation of Switzerland to these initiatives, and the role of climate science knowledge in financial policymaking.
